machines.title: Draft Day
machines.blurb: Merge stays closed until the draft is approved. Each seat is scored once.

invariants.name: NoMergeWithoutApproval
invariants.text: A merged draft was approved first.

invariants.name: AtMostOnce
invariants.text: Each seat is scored at most once.

invariants.name: JudgedBeforeGraft
invariants.text: Graft waits until every seat has been scored.

story.label: An idea is on the board.
The draft PR is up. Approve it.
Merge is allowed only after approval.
